title: Google Pixel 11 Pro review: Magic Capture and the voice-to-text Rambler features are very useful but subpar gaming performance and HiLight is useless (Julian Chokkattu/Wired)
summary: Julian Chokkattu / Wired: Google Pixel 11 Pro review: Magic Capture and the voice-to-text Rambler features are very useful but subpar gaming performance and HiLight is useless — Google's new voice typing is pure magic, but subpar gaming performance and a useless rear LED keep these flagships from true greatness. — Buy Now
